title: Monoidal reduction/pullback square before applying the total limit
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with $\ell$ invertible in every residue field of $X,Y$. Use completed coefficients [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Write $S_W$ for ordinary tensor, $F_f$ for ordinary ringed pullback, $L_W$ for coherent reduction, $t_W$ for coherent system tensor and $P_f$ for sequence inverse image [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation, lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core]. Let $a_f:L_XF_f\simeq P_fL_Y$ and $b_W:L_WS_W\simeq t_W(L_W-,L_W-)$ be the uniquely normalized comparisons of [lem-sf-pullback-reduction-augmentation] and [lem-sf-tensor-reduction-augmentation]. Let $v_f:F_fS_Y\simeq S_X(F_f-,F_f-)$ be the canonical ordinary comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], using exactly the specified ordinary tensor representatives, and let $w_f:P_ft_Y\simeq t_X(P_f-,P_f-)$ be the canonical coherent comparison of [lem-pur-coherent-derived-pullback-tensor]. For all ambient derived objects $M,N$ on $Y$, in the derived system category on $X$ one has $a_f(S_Y(M,N));P_f(b_Y(M,N));w_f(L_YM,L_YN)=L_X(v_f(M,N));b_X(F_fM,F_fN);t_X(a_f(M),a_f(N))$. This is an equation before applying the total limit; it has no completion augmentation maps, no constructible restriction and no inverse reduction/limit counits.

proof.text: Choose the existing normalized operations, realization and ringed models. Identify the ordinary tensor models by normalized localization isomorphisms.

The single-input pullback augmentation identification and the primitive quotient adjunct equation identify the specified pullback reduction comparison with the realization comparison, by uniqueness. The tensor-reduction identification identifies both specified tensor comparisons.

Apply the existing canonical reduction-tensor-pullback square to the normalized ringed models. Naturality of the pullback reduction comparison across the source tensor isomorphism and transport of canonical tensor pullback across the tensor model isomorphisms conjugate this square to the stated one.

lean.statement:
theorem reductionTensorPullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E Y)) :
    (pullbackReductionComparison l E f).hom.app
        ((tensorModel l E Y).tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
        ((tensorReductionComparison l E Y).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
        ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).reduction.obj M,
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).reduction.obj N) =
    (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction.map
        ((proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
          ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)
          (tensorModel l E Y) (tensorModel l E X)).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (tensorReductionComparison l E X).hom.app
        ((PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj M,
          (PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj N) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackReductionComparison l E f).hom.app M)
          ((pullbackReductionComparison l E f).hom.app N))
